title: Globally, more people expect AI to cause job loss than growth
discussion_signal: The post interprets Pew’s 37-country findings as a wide public expectation that AI will reduce jobs and widen inequality, contrasting enterprise productivity language with worker concerns about roles, entry paths, training, and career progression.
linked_research_question: Why do publics more often expect AI to reduce jobs and widen inequality than to create broad opportunity, and what social protections make that bargain credible?
limits: The post is a secondary interpretation of Pew survey results
Expectations are not forecasts or observed employment outcomes
The commentary adds a policy interpretation that is not itself measured in the Pew survey
